name: embraer-e195-e2-msfs
description: Embraer E195-E2 study-level addon para Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024. Arquitetura: flight model + core de sistemas em C++/WASM, aviônicos (Primus Epic 2.0) em React/TypeScript sobre Coherent GT.

scripts.build: npm run build:wasm && npm run build:avionics
scripts.build:wasm: cmake -S src/wasm -B src/wasm/build -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release && cmake --build src/wasm/build --config Release
scripts.test: npm run test:wasm && npm run test:avionics
scripts.test:wasm: ctest --test-dir src/wasm/build --output-on-failure || echo 'Sem suíte GoogleTest configurada ainda — ver Fase 1'
